evals.name: eval-branch-dirty-main
evals.prompt: Start a new OpenSpec change called add-csv-export for exporting greetings as CSV.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to branch or scaffold because main has uncommitted changes; reports the status and the options.
assertions: Still on main
No new branch was created
No change directory openspec/changes/add-csv-export was created
The uncommitted README edit is still uncommitted and unstashed
The report tells the user the tree is not clean

evals.name: eval-branch-clean-main
evals.prompt: Start a new OpenSpec change called fix-login-timeout (just scaffold it, don't write the artifacts yet).
evals.expected_output: Creates and checks out bugfix/fix-login-timeout from main, then scaffolds the change on it without committing.
assertions: Branch bugfix/fix-login-timeout exists and is checked out
The branch starts at main's HEAD with no new commits
The change directory openspec/changes/fix-login-timeout exists
main is unchanged

evals.name: eval-apply-three-tasks
evals.expected_output: Commits the planning artifacts, then one commit per task (1.1, 1.2, 2.1) with conventional subjects, leaving the unrelated scratch-notes.txt untouched.
assertions: Still on feat/add-greeting and main is unchanged
A planning-artifacts commit exists: feat(add-greeting): add planning artifacts
Exactly one commit per task, subjects start with feat(add-greeting): task 1.1 / 1.2 / 2.1
Every commit subject is 72 characters or fewer
scratch-notes.txt was never committed and is still untracked
All tasks in tasks.md are ticked
The test suite passes
Working tree is clean apart from scratch-notes.txt
The report does not treat the pre-existing scratch-notes.txt as blocking
No commit was amended

evals.name: eval-finish-local
evals.prompt: I just ran /opsx:archive for add-greeting and it completed successfully. Finish it up.
evals.expected_output: Commits the archive move on the branch, merges into main with --no-ff, deletes the branch, does not push.
assertions: Archive commit on the branch: feat(add-greeting): archive change
Now on main
main HEAD is a merge commit with two parents and subject merge: add-greeting
Branch feat/add-greeting was deleted
Working tree is clean
No commit was amended
The merge commit carries the same trailers as the branch's archive commit

evals.name: eval-apply-on-main
evals.expected_output: Notices apply is starting on main and stops to offer creating the change branch instead of committing on main.
assertions: No commit was added to main
The report flags that apply started on main and offers to create a branch
